name: Omni Louisville Hotel
positioning: Downtown Louisville hotel with a heated rooftop pool, a full-service spa and interiors inspired by the city's heritage
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable downtown base near Main Street and Whiskey Row
Guests attending events at the Kentucky International Convention Center

facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Kentucky International Convention Center.
Main Street, Fourth Street Live, the Whiskey Row distilleries and the Louisville Slugger Museum & Factory are all less than a mile from the hotel.
Churchill Downs, home of the Kentucky Derby, is a quick drive away.
Elements of the city's heritage and culture are woven throughout the hotel's interior.
Guest rooms are appointed with furnishings inspired by the city's history.
The Luxury accommodation has a living area with a full dining room, a wet bar and sectional seating.
The rooftop pool is on the third floor.
There is a firepit by the pool.
Mokara Spa & Salon offers facials, body treatments and salon services.
The hotel has a fully-equipped fitness center.
Seven dining outlets include two full-service restaurants, two bars, a grab-and-go market, a speakeasy and a tasting room.
The hotel is pet friendly for dogs and cats up to 25 pounds.

highlights.text: A heated rooftop pool, where The Water Company serves light bites seasonally.
Pin + Proof is a Prohibition-style speakeasy where guests can bowl while sipping signature cocktails.
Suites have separate sleeping quarters and floor-to-ceiling city views.
Falls City Market turns Liberty Street into a pedestrian thoroughfare shared by hotel guests and locals.

considerations.text: Parking is valet with a nightly charge; the public self-parking garages behind the hotel have no direct access into the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
